idle_prompt: The person shown in the reference image stands upright in the same spot for the whole video, looking exactly as they appear in the reference image: same face, same hairstyle, same clothing, same body shape, and the same background behind them. The person stays almost still: feet planted firmly on the ground, legs and hips completely still, shoulders level and relaxed, torso upright without swaying, with only gentle natural breathing and no large or sudden movements. The face holds a calm, neutral, relaxed expression that never changes, lips closed at all times, no smile and no frown. The camera is locked on a tripod and completely static, holding the same angle, distance and framing throughout, and the background stays exactly consistent with the reference image: every object in the scene is perfectly still. Stable, smooth, high quality video.

_comment: 2026-11-08 全身稳定版提示词（用户实看后要求：整个人物稳定+背景稳定）。三个教训写进设计：(1) 旧产线 stage_scail 不传 --recipe 默认 scail_guizi.json，其 which=greet/idle 二分让 talk/comfort/encourage 全套 idle 的 'no large or sudden movements'——文本压制与驱动视频动作对抗，动作段发僵发怪；(2) regen_scail 第134行 negative='' 写死，节点4（负向）实际接进 WanSCAILToVideo 114/182，喂文本即生效；(3) 闭嘴必须保留——引擎运行时 wav2lip 在 full_imgs 上画口型，生成段嘴动会双重嘴。身份/服装/背景一律指代参考图（沿 guizi 2026-10-28 原则）。首句固定 'The person shown in the reference image' 供 appearance 替换。
